payload.design: 654 hosts, outer resamples r = 0-29 x seeds 0-4, 164 test hosts per resample

estimator.concentration_factor: exp(mean regret / kB T) at 1000 K, kB from scipy.constants (eV/K); interval = the map of the regret interval; mean_population_ratio = mean over hosts of exp(-regret / kB T) with the regret averaging
estimator.conditional_on_miss: sum regret / number of misses per resample (same averaging)
estimator.mean: per resample sum over eligible hosts / number of eligible hosts; point = mean over the 30 resamples; replicate = mean over slots of sum(w x) / sum(w eligible) on HierDraws.make([164] * 30, 2000, 20261008); 95% = 2.5 / 97.5 percentiles
estimator.phs_truncation: PHS entries per host counted from the raw release (is_shallow true, charge 0); partially filtered = universe host with >= 1 PHS entry removed; selection recomputed with those hosts ineligible on the same draws
estimator.quantiles: median and 90th percentile of regret over eligible host appearances pooled over the 30 resamples (inverted CDF); replicate = weighted quantile with the draw weights
estimator.regret: per host E_f(DFT) of the lowest-predicted site (seed ensemble; first in site_id order on a tie) minus the host's DFT minimum over its tested retained sites; zero on a hit
estimator.separated_hosts: eligible hosts whose two lowest DFT sites differ by more than delta; exact hit rate there; chance = mean of 1 / n_sites

payload.label: site-selection regret: DFT energy of the lowest-predicted oxygen site above the host minimum, hit within delta, selection on separated hosts, PHS truncation of hosts; S, D, D* at 654 hosts, 30 x 5
